idea-plugin.name: Luggage Plugin Development
idea-plugin.description:
Zero-config developer tooling for Luggage MUD client plugin authors.

Open any Luggage plugin folder and you immediately get:

  • manifest.json validation + autocomplete (JSON Schema)
  • client.* autocomplete inside index.js (bundled luggage.d.ts)
  • File → New → Luggage Plugin — scaffolds manifest.json, panel.html, panel.css, index.js
  • Live templates: lsend, lon, lcapture, ltrigger, ltimer, lstorage

Detection is shape-based — the plugin activates only inside folders that contain a Luggage manifest.json, so unrelated JS projects are untouched.

IDE support. Schema validation, the scaffolder, and file templates work everywhere — IntelliJ IDEA (Community + Ultimate), WebStorm, PhpStorm, PyCharm (Community + Pro), RubyMine, GoLand, Rider, RustRover, DataGrip. The client.* autocomplete inside index.js needs the bundled JavaScript plugin, so it lights up on Ultimate / WebStorm / PhpStorm / PyCharm Pro / RubyMine / GoLand / Rider / RustRover / DataGrip but is skipped on Community editions.
